//: Server GC for the headless runner. A script's working set is a few very large arrays and a great many short-lived values around them; workstation GC collects those on the one thread that is also running the script, and a gen-0 sweep in the middle of a fifty-million-element statement is time the statement pays for. Server GC gives the collector a heap and a thread per core, which is what the rest of M93 assumes when it hands the arithmetic to every core the machine has.
